page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top to bottom: title lines in roman and italic capitals, a Latin paragraph in italic, a German black letter line, a woodcut of a fish in the middle, the imprint at the foot. No margins with text.

main_text.l: Latinis, Gracis, Italicis, Hispanicis, Gallicis, Germanicis, Anglicis,
aliisq; interdum, per certos ordines digesta,

p.i: Explicantur autem singulorum nomina ac nominum rationes, praesertim in Latina & Graeca lingua vberrimè: & nominum confirmandorum causa descriptiones quorundam, & alia quaedam, praesertim in magno nostro De Aquatilibus volumine non tradita, adduntur: deq; singulis Rondeletij, Bellonij, Saluiani, & nostra sententia explicantur breuissimè.
